title: Personal Training Packages: which package a session redemption or expiration draws from when a member holds more than one
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states which of a member's open personal-training packages a session redemption or an expiration forfeiture is drawn from, when the member holds more than one open package.

## Rule
When a member holds more than one open personal-training package, a session redemption or an expiration forfeiture is drawn from the package with the soonest expiration date among the member's open packages. Where two open packages share the same expiration date, the package that was opened earlier -- the one with the earlier purchase date -- is drawn from first.

## Points of judgement
This draw order applies only when a member's open packages would otherwise leave more than one package eligible to supply the same redemption or forfeiture; a member holding only one open package has no such choice to make. The soonest-expiration-date rule is applied first: whichever open package is closest to expiring supplies the session or absorbs the forfeiture. Only if two or more open packages are tied on expiration date does the earlier purchase date become the deciding factor, so that the package a member has held longest among those tied is drawn from before a more recently purchased package with the identical expiration date.
